Corporate Profile Kunlun Energy (Stock Code: 00135.HK) is an international energy company controlled by China National Petroleum Corporation (CNPC) and listed on the Main Board of The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong Limited. The Company serves as the primary financing and investment platform for CNPC’s natural gas business, as well as the management platform Development Vision for its integrated natural gas terminal utilisation business. The Company’s strategic portfolio encompasses urban gas, Liquefied Natural Gas (LNG), Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG), gas-to-power and new energy.
